scope: Existing group_left/group_right float range expressions reuse completed exact-clock operand discovery through the current pair owner. No language feature, raw history cache or public interface is added.

reference.lineage: Unchanged verified retained upstream executable/source/compiler binding; fresh evaluations, no new Go build.

algorithm: Keep unique full float rows; require signature uniqueness on the declared one side.
Enumerate each many-side row, resolve its one-side counterpart and preserve original-side pair positions.
Resolve exact frozen cache keys in many-to-one label order; reject conflicting ordinal assignments and missing required mappings.
Retain original cold scans, reservations, deferred duplicates, diagnostics and successful Done before publishing membership.
Reuse only exact-clock membership and pair positions; read selected operands afresh. Ambiguous/mixed/aliased/filled/delayed shapes retain ordinary evaluation.
foreign_scope: Compiled ARM64/ARM32 under QEMU, both profiles; selected units and page17 original cases, not complete foreign suites.
caller_scope: Both true grouped directions, three output rows, complete labels/bits/clocks, pages1/17/1024 and provider failures. Shared legacy C cases were not rerun as a full suite.

resources.interpretation: Engine observations across identical full outcomes. Acquired bytes are cumulative allocation traffic, not peak RAM or process RSS.

timing.measurement: Five alternating before/candidate pairs per profile. Each of ten fixed cases has warm and measured execution; all400 complete responses and each binary own nonelapsed observations must match prior qualification.
timing.limits: Shared host without CPU/frequency isolation. Engine execution including preparation, synthetic in-memory provider; not HTTP, production DBengine disk I/O, process RSS or universal throughput.

static.msrv: Installed Rust1.91.0, all-targets fixtures compilation only.

limitations: Finite same-input expression and selected target evidence; no universal language proof.
Synthetic engine timing, not HTTP or production DBengine disk throughput.
Raw inputs remain paged, but cardinality metadata and owned output can grow; limits stay disabled.
Earlier SRE, broader language, live-Agent, sanitizer and CI cohorts retain actual historical identities; no fresh pass is claimed.
